name: Taxitower
ability: Paleomycelium (its own: Grass moves get STAB; immune to Leech Seed, powder and spore moves) / Effect Spore (hidden)
look: a colossal tapering obelisk of banded slate and fungal tissue with glowing mycelium, petrified shelf-fungus armour, buttress roots and a crown split open like a chimney venting a cloud of golden spores
entry: Towering over ancient swamps, Taxitower absorbed nutrients from the surrounding soil through miles of underground threads. When threatened, it releases blinding clouds of prehistoric spores that haven't been breathed in eons.
